title: Sign in
say: KHOJI links people, actions and money. Sign-in here is a UI gate for the demo only.

title: Dashboard
say: Every number is computed from scripted seed data: alerts, risk distribution and top patterns.

title: Alerts list
say: Filter to High, then open the hero alert, ALT-2024-001.

title: Alert overview
say: A risk level with reasons, never a single score. Derived facts and related entities.

title: Transaction graph
say: A circular transfer A to B to C to A, with dashed links to the employee credentials.

title: Timeline
say: Mobile change, cooling-period override, beneficiary added, then a MFA that passed on a tainted number.

title: Employee activity
say: Valid permissions, misused: signals P1 to P10 are signals, not findings of intent.

title: Evidence and control path
say: Tainted MFA, the hollow control path, missing CCTV, and a real downloadable document.

title: But-for replay
say: Toggle the mobile change: the path fails. This result is precomputed in the prototype.

title: Legitimate twin
say: Same actions, different authorization: the divergence point explains why the twin stays quiet.

title: Exposure (Reach)
say: Other accounts in the same state before any transfer. Values are scenario values, precomputed.

title: Splitting and payout twin
say: Structuring after two limit raises versus a payout batch under a pre-dated mandate.

title: Profile mismatch
say: Observed inflow far above declared income, and the profile edit that hid the mismatch.

title: Assign, status, decision
say: Assign to an investigator, move the status, and record a decision with a required rationale.

title: Report and export
say: Generate the report, download the hashed evidence pack and verify it.

title: Evaluation plan
say: Evaluation is pending. This page states what will be measured and against which baselines.
